blocks.text: Multi-cloud tareeqe mein alag alag providers ki kai cloud services istemal ki jati hain. Is se kisi ek provider par dependency (sahara / mohtaji) nahi rehta, aur bharosa (reliability) aur performance (kaam kitna tez aur achha ho raha hai) behtar ho sakti hai.

Misal (Example): ek company data analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, apni enterprise (business wali) applications ke liye Microsoft Azure, aur backup aur disaster recovery (kisi bari kharabi ya hadse ke baad data wapas lana) ke liye Amazon Web Services istemal kar sakti hai. Is tarah agar ek provider mein masla aaye to company doosri services par bharosa kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Multi-cloud hybrid cloud se kaise alag alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud ko milati hai. Multi-cloud mein alag alag providers ki kai cloud services istemal hoti hain taake ek provider par dependency na rahe.

items: Multi-cloud: alag alag providers ki services (Google Cloud, Azure, AWS).
Ek provider par dependency nahi; ek mein masla ho to doosre kaam aate hain.
